# Parish Library

The parish library needs a printable index of the daily readings so that the
choir can prepare the service in advance. A reader opens the catalogue, picks a
saint or a feast day, and prints a short sheet with the readings for that day.

The first version stays small on purpose: a searchable list, a print view and a
plain text export. Editing the catalogue, accounts and syncing between devices
are deliberately postponed until the print flow works well.
